findings.description: Modal 'Display name' and 'Email' inputs have no associated <label>; the placeholder is the only labelling, so the field/label relationship is not programmatic.
Page header and content area are generic <div>s; no <header> or <main> landmark exposes the page structure.
User data inputs (display name, email) have no autocomplete attribute (expected e.g. autocomplete="nickname"/"name" and "email").
Footer text #888888 on #ffffff at 0.85rem is 3.54:1, below 4.5:1. Suggested fix: #767676 (4.54:1).
Search field border #cccccc on #ffffff is 1.61:1, below 3:1 required to perceive the input boundary. Suggested: #939393 or darker.
Modal input borders #cccccc on #ffffff are 1.61:1 (need 3:1).
Create Task focus indicator is a 1px #e0e0e0 outline on #ffffff: 1.32:1, below 3:1.
Details appear on mouseover and disappear on mouseout of the trigger; moving the pointer onto the revealed content hides it (not hoverable), and it never appears on keyboard focus.
Project cards navigate via onclick on a <div> with no tabindex or key handler; unreachable and inoperable by keyboard.
Status dropdown and its .option items are <div>s toggled by onclick only; not focusable, no Enter/Space/arrow key support.
Project details are revealed only on mouseover; no keyboard (focus/click) way to show them.
No skip link and no <main> landmark; bypassing the fixed header relies on heading navigation only. Verify whether repeated blocks exist across the app.
Positive tabindex="5" puts the search field first in tab order regardless of DOM position, disrupting the logical sequence.
Opening the Settings modal does not move focus into it, and closing (Save) does not return focus to the 'Open Settings' trigger; focus stays behind the overlay.
Global '*:focus { outline: none; }' removes the focus indicator from all focusable elements (search input, Open Settings, modal inputs, Save) without any replacement style.
The only replacement focus style is a 1px #e0e0e0 outline (1.32:1 on white), which is not visibly perceivable.
Fixed header (position:fixed, z-index:100, ~70px tall) with no scroll-padding-top; focused elements scrolled to the top of the viewport can be entirely hidden beneath it.
Modal inputs 'Display name' and 'Email' have placeholder-only labels that disappear when typing.
Search field has no visible label, only placeholder 'Search tasks...'.
Clickable cards behave as links but expose no role (link) to assistive technology.
Custom dropdown exposes no role (combobox/button + listbox), no aria-expanded state, and options have no role=option/aria-selected.
Disclosure trigger is a <div> with no role=button and no aria-expanded.
Settings modal has no role="dialog", no aria-modal="true" and no accessible name (aria-labelledby to its h3).
